config.label: Deployment to read: mainnet, testnet, or robinhood
config.description: Deployment to read: mainnet, testnet, or robinhood. Defaults to mainnet.

config.label: Sub-account the agent trades from
config.description: Sub-account the agent trades from. Read-only tools work without it.

config.label: API key slot bound to the sub-account, 0 to 254
config.description: API key slot bound to the sub-account, 0 to 254.

config.label: API key private key
config.description: API key private key. Full write authority over the account it is bound to, so use a dedicated sub-account.

config.label: Per-order notional ceiling in USD
config.description: Per-order notional ceiling in USD. Required before any order can be signed.

config.label: Layer-2 chain id bound into every signature
config.description: Layer-2 chain id bound into every signature. Mainnet uses 304 and testnet 300, so this is only needed on a deployment that publishes none.

config.label: Read-only token for account observation without a signing key
config.description: Read-only token for account observation without a signing key.
